resume_not_feasible_reason: HPADJ20 is a source-locked monolithic exact LP replay whose current proof object is a single global aggregate. Introducing execution partitions before hostile audit would change the producer/evidence contract rather than merely resume the same audited computation.
cancellation_recovery: Discard incomplete runner-local output and re-arm only by advancing the dedicated run-key generation, or manually redispatch the identical exact head when the workflow is dispatchable. Partial output grants no mathematical or merge credit.

partition.reason: No stable exact subunit certificate boundary exists in the current source-locked HPADJ20 producer.

storage_preflight.final_output_persistence: GitHub Actions job log only; /tmp/hpadj20.json remains runner-local and is discarded with the runner.
storage_preflight.stop_condition: No artifact upload is authorized; if the execution contract, run key, or producer lock drifts, fail before heavy compute.
storage_preflight.authorization: PR runs require the dedicated run-key file to change in the exact event before..head range, armed=true, and a strictly positive/advancing generation. Reopened events are cold. Manual dispatch requires an exact 40-hex expected_head_sha.
